body: We present TwinStore, a source-available synthetic consumer platform for physical retail built on vision--language models. TwinStore turns a store into a digital twin---from 82 ready-made formats, a floor-plan image or phone photos of its shelves---and fills it with synthetic shoppers who plan a trip, walk the aisles and decide what to buy by looking at rendered shelves with packs, price tags and promotion signs. Every trip ends in a receipt, so a layout, price, pack or promotion can be tried on the same shoppers before it reaches the store. Around this core, TwinStore provides 3D playback, paired comparisons and layout optimization, shopper interviews, a trade-area model, counterfactual edits of real shelf photos, a marketing studio with eleven tools, and an assistant that turns a plain sentence into a drafted study or an answer grounded in a run's own numbers. In a held-out validation on eleven public datasets, simulated receipts approach the households' own natural variation (category-mix divergence 0.017--0.018 against a real drift of 0.012), price elasticities fall inside the range measured in the field, and three independent decision models agree. TwinStore runs on cloud or on-device models and is distributed with installers for Windows, macOS and Linux.
summaryZh: TwinStore：使用视觉语言模型的综合消费者平台。我们推出 TwinStore，这是一个基于视觉语言模型的用于实体零售的可用源综合消费者平台。 TwinStore 将商店变成了数字孪生——由 82 种现成的格式、平面图图像或货架的手机照片组成——并充满了合成购物者，他们计划旅行，在过道上走动，通过查看渲染的货架上的包装、价格标签和促销标志来决定购买什么。
